key.name: show-radial-menu
key.description: Shortcut that raises the radial menu. The menu stays up while this shortcut's modifiers are held, and the selection is applied when they are released.

key.name: snap-preview
key.description: Whether the region a window would be given is outlined while the menu is up, so the choice can be seen before it is made.

key.name: snap-animation
key.description: Whether a snapped window is seen to travel from where it was into its new region, or simply appears there.

key.name: snap-animation-curve
key.description: How the window moves on its way to its region. One of "expo", "quint", "md", "cubic", "quad", "spring", "back". An unrecognised value falls back to "quint".

key.name: snap-outer-gap
key.description: Space, in pixels, between a snapped window and the edge of the work area, on all four sides.

key.name: snap-inner-gap
key.description: Total space, in pixels, between two windows snapped to neighbouring regions. Filling the work area ignores this and honours the outer gap alone.
